description: Margin discriminator (kill-check MAJOR-2): 'bb' overlaps previous-speaker 0.10 s / new-speaker 0.35 s -> margin EXACTLY 0.25 s, NOT < 0.25 -> plain winner switches (SPK_2). 'cc' overlaps SPK_2 0.15 s / SPK_1 0.25 s -> margin 0.10 s < 0.25 -> CARRIES previous speaker SPK_2 although the duration-weighted winner is SPK_1 (disabling the hysteresis branch turns 'cc' into SPK_1 and changes the block split). 'dd' switches cleanly (0.40 s margin).
